title: ZuCo 1.0: Simultaneous EEG and Eye-Tracking during Natural Reading
description: ZuCo 1.0 is a dataset of simultaneous 128-channel EEG and eye-tracking recorded while adult native English speakers read natural sentences. Participants completed sentiment reading, normal reading, and task-specific reading paradigms. The dataset provides a resource for studying the neural and oculomotor correlates of natural language comprehension.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 128-channel EGI Geodesic system at 500 Hz with a Cz reference. Eye movements were recorded simultaneously from the left eye with an EyeLink 1000 at 500 Hz. Each reading block is stored as a run, with gaze and pupil samples as physio recordings and fixations, saccades, and blinks in the events files.
